Water was leaking from the A/C in my room, and there was a faint squeaking noise from outside or a neighboring room, which disrupted the ambience. Decent for the massage quality, but the space needs improvement to justify the price and deliver a more rejuvenating experience.

Literally, it was the worst experience of my life.
I have been a member of Elite Luxury Spa for over 2 years but I have been to Malad outlet only twice because of the kind of therapists they have and the kind of customer service that they give.

I told them about all my requirements and needs, they agreed and said will convey it to the therapist and give me the best one that is available.

What is more disappointing is that, the receptionist rather than asking me about my experience or apologising to me for the error made by the therapist, she is saying ‘If I would have known that you would take this long, I would have refunded your money and asked you to leave’.
I mean, are you serious?

I understand that it is your closing time and everything but 10 mins hardly makes a difference especially when you want to retain a customer.

The arrogance that staff have at this particular location is beyond comprehension.
I feel that I wasted my hours here today because the therapy was terrible and the customer service even worse.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Respected Owner of Sukho Thai,

Disappointed with your manager behaviour.

Building a brand and earning customer trust takes years of dedication and consistent service. However, even one employee's behavior can tarnish this hard-earned reputation. While I have consistently found your masseurs to be skilled, professional, and dedicated, the conduct of your manager has been troubling.

Today, during a session, your manager asked for payment, interrupting the experience because she wanted to close the account early. Such actions are unacceptable and unprofessional. A manager should always treat customers with respect and politeness, regardless of the situation, if really she wanted to close the account early can ask us to pay the advance and we don’t mind that or she should wait for the customer to finish the session.

We choose Sukho Thai for the quality of the treatments, even though the facilities may not be as up-to-date as those of other spas. This speaks to our appreciation for the good service your masseurs provide. However, our loyalty is being tested by the rude and dismissive attitude of your manager.

Instead of addressing our concerns, she rudely told me to leave and threatened not to accept any future appointments. This is not only unprofessional but also detrimental to your business. Customer satisfaction and respect are paramount for any business to thrive.

I hope you understand the gravity of this situation and take steps to improve the managerial conduct at your spa. Ensuring polite and respectful customer interaction is crucial for maintaining your brand’s reputation and continued success.

Why we choose brands because of trust and reliability.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

I recently visited the Swami Charan Abhyanga Kansya Thali Foot Spa in Mahim, Mumbai, and I can confidently say it was a transformative experience deserving of a 5-star review! This Ayurvedic holistic treatment, rooted in the ancient practice of Padabhyanga, uses a bronze Kansa Thali to deliver a deeply rejuvenating foot massage, and the benefits I experienced were truly remarkable.

From the moment I stepped into the Mahim branch, the ambiance was serene and welcoming, with a positive energy that instantly put me at ease. The staff was professional, humble, and attentive, taking the time to explain the process and benefits of the Kansya Thali foot massage. The treatment itself was a perfect blend of traditional Ayurvedic techniques and modern technology, using high-quality herbal oils and a pure Kansa (bronze) bowl to stimulate the Marma points on my feet.

The advantages of this treatment are numerous. Firstly, it significantly reduced my stress and anxiety, leaving me feeling relaxed and grounded. The circular motions and gentle pressure applied with the Kansa Thali improved my blood circulation, which alleviated the heaviness in my legs after long workdays. I also noticed a marked improvement in my digestion and a reduction in body heat, which is a common issue for me. The therapy is designed to balance the Tridoshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha), and I could feel a sense of harmony in my body after just one session. Additionally, my cracked heels felt softer, and the overall detoxification effect left me refreshed and energized.

What sets Swami Charan apart is their commitment to affordability and quality. The Mahim center is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with modern Padabhyanga machines, making the experience both authentic and comfortable. The staff’s dedication to personalized care, combined with their use of high-quality herbal products like Swami Charan Pain Oil, enhanced the therapeutic benefits. I also appreciated their holistic approach, which not only focuses on physical healing but also uplifts your mental and emotional well-being.
I highly recommend the Swami Charan Abhyanga Kansya Thali Foot Spa in Mahim to anyone seeking a natural, effective way to improve their health and well-being. Whether you’re dealing with stress, joint pain, or simply want to pamper yourself, this treatment is a game-changer.

I’m already looking forward to my next visit and plan to make this a regular part of my wellness routine
